item.title: Public Schools Should Not Be Government Speech Domains
item.description: A Nebraska lawsuit aims to protect students and parents from classroom indoctrination.

item.title: Study: Justice Jackson Speaks More Than Twice as Often as Colleagues
item.description: During Supreme Court oral arguments, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson is notably talkative, speaking more than any other justice.

item.title: Rep. Mace Proposes Bill to Reinstate Death Penalty in D.C.
item.description: Rep. Nancy Mace aims to restore capital punishment in Washington, D.C., 45 years after its abolition.

item.title: Massachusetts Mayor Charged with Misusing Pandemic Funds
item.description: The FBI arrested Lawrence's mayor, accusing him of diverting pandemic aid to his political campaign.
